description: Turn your ancient Android tablet into a beautiful digital photo frame. LegacyPhotoFrame is a free, open-source photo frame app built for legacy devices. It is designed to run on bare-minimum systems that cannot support other functionality. DISCLAIMER: AI Usage All code and documentation written for this project was done by hand, by humans. Please consult the README in our source code for more information. Features: - Lightweight, Android-native design with no fluff for low-RAM devices - Configurable auto-start and auto-stop functionality for preserving hardware - Automatic keep-awake functionality while app is active - And, of course, no ads
